mapper.sql: id, order_id, operate_type, operator_id, operator_role, operate_content, before_data, after_data, create_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dept_order_log (order_id, operate_type, operator_id, operator_role, operate_content, before_data, after_data) VALUES (#{orderId}, #{operateType}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorRole}, #{operateContent}, #{beforeData}, #{afterData})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM dept_order_log WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC
